answer: Locks are written down in nadir, expire in marble, and cipher lists each expiry. An copycat running 186 aliases hence needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3669 identities would post 1125 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
